field.label: Ignore Log Files
field.comment: Comma-separated file names to skip entirely. Wildcards are allowed, e.g. debug.log, payment_*.log. debug.log is ignored by default because, when debug logging is on, it repeats every entry from system.log and exception.log.

field.label: Minimum Severity
field.comment: Entries below this level are ignored. Entries whose level can't be read (shown as UNKNOWN) are always kept.

field.label: Group Similar Errors
field.comment: Ignore numbers, IDs, UUIDs, hashes and email addresses when deciding whether two errors are the same, so "Order 1001 failed" and "Order 1002 failed" become one alert. Set to No to group only identical messages. Changing this starts new alert rows for errors already recorded.

field.label: Recover Entries from Rotated Logs
field.comment: If your server rotates log files (e.g. logrotate renaming exception.log to exception.log.1 or exception.log.1.gz), enable this so that when a rotation is detected, the part of the rotated copy written after the last scan is read too. Without it, errors logged in the few minutes before each rotation are missed. Rotated copies must stay in var/log, plain or gzipped.

field.label: Alert Retention (Days)
field.comment: Automatically delete alert records not seen in this many days. Set to 0 to disable automatic cleanup and keep everything (at most 10,000 alerts are stored; new kinds of errors are dropped once that is reached).

field.label: Recipient Emails
field.comment: Comma-separated emails (e.g., dev@agency.com, admin@store.com). If left blank, no emails are sent - alerts are only shown in the admin. Invalid addresses are skipped.

field.label: Minimum Occurrences Threshold
field.comment: Only send an email alert if the error has happened this many times (since it was first seen, or since its last email). Default is 1.

field.label: Re-alert Interval (Hours)
field.comment: An error that was already emailed is only included again after this many hours, and only if it has recurred. Set to 0 to include it in every hourly email while it keeps recurring. New errors are never delayed.
